title.narrative: Organise export training school days and certification with GEPA

"Organise export training school days and certification with Dutch Export Academy HBP supported member SMEs to participate in the Dutch Export Academy (DEA) 5th Edition. The DEA aims to support the capacity development and export readiness of horticulture SMEs by subsidizing their participation in the Dutch Export Academy (DEA) program. A total of 18 companies participated in the DEA 5th Edition, with 10 being HBP members supported through financial subsidies. The Dutch Export Academy (DEA) is an initiative by GNBCC in partnership with MDF West Africa, aimed at preparing Ghanaian SMEs to successfully export to the European Union, especially through the Netherlands. The 5th edition ran from May to November 2024 and consisted of a 9-day local training in Ghana, a 3-day intermission, and a 5-day export study tour in the Netherlands. Through the DEA, SMEs benefit from the program’s high-quality training, coaching, and international exposure and international market. The training covered topics including export processes, logistics, export finance, negotiation, branding, certification, and legal contracting. The export study tour in the Netherlands exposed participants to EU market requirements, matched them with Dutch businesses, and included visits to institutions such as the Netherlands Enterprise Agency (RvO), World Horti Centre, CBI, and the Ghanaian Embassy."
